Protect the key saved on this device wit: Kurinda urufunguzo rwakorewe kuri iki gikoresho ukoresheje ijambo ryihariye (passphrase) cyangwa passkey. Nymbot izagusaba iryo jambo buri gihe yifungura, kandi nta kintu cyose kizajya gishyirwa mu mazi cyangwa ngo kirembeze kugeza igihe yafunguwe. Niba uyibuze, urufunguzo ruri kuri iki gikoresho ntushobora koroshoza, bityo reka urufunguzo rwawe rwa nsec rugaruke ahantu hateguwe neza.

Kurinda urugero rwanditse kuri iki gikoresho ukoresheje ijambo ryihariye. Nymbot izagusaba iryo jambo buri gihe ryifungura, kandi nta kintu cyose kigakorana cyangwa ngo kirembiwe kugeza igihe yafunguye. Iyo wibagiwe, urugero ruri kuri iki gikoresho ntshobora gusubizwa, bityo raba ko uba wubatse nsec yawe ahantu heza kandi hafite umutekano.

Kurinda ikintu cy'ingenzi (key) cyatunganyijwe kuri ubu bwoko bw'icyuma ukoresheje ikiganza cyawe cyangwa ijosi ryawe. Nymbot izagusaba kubikoresha buri gihe igiye gufungurwa, kandi nta kintu na kimwe kizashyirwa mu buryo bwo gusangira cyangwa ngo kirindwe kugeza igihe yafunguye. Nta jambo ry'ibanga rishobora gukoreshwa niba ibyo byaje guhinduka: niba imikoreshereze y'ikiganza cyangwa ijosi ryawe ihindutse, ukeneye nsec yawe n'icyapa cyo gusubiramo (recovery code) byatunganyijwe, bityo bika aho ari hacyo bukeye.
Protection against harvest-now-decrypt-l: Kurinda uburyo bwo "gusya ubu hanyuma ukabica nyuma". Icyatunganyijwe (wrap) cyawe cyashyizweho ibintu byombi X25519 na ML-KEM-768, kandi ibanga rya mbere (shared secret) ryakuwe mu bintu byombi hamwe — bityo umujura w'amakuru wibika aya makuru uyu munsi agomba kurusha lattice hamwe na curve kugira ngo ayasome.

So a relay holding your traffic sees an:
Nuko ubufatanyabikorwa (relay) buhuza umuyoboro wawe bubona ibimenyetso biva kuri urutonde (key) ruriho gusa kuri uwo muntu,
rubonye n'igihe (timestamp) kitari cyihariye — bushobora kumenya ko ubutumwa ari ubw'i Nymbot, ariko si uwo butumwa buturuka. Isuzuma ry'amakuru y'inyongezo (metadata) rishingiye ku bupfundo (wraps) rirangwa n'ibintu bike cyane.
